arguments.goal: mac2mac: a CLI that lets one Mac dispatch a task to another Mac via Claude Agent SDK and stream the result back. v0 = one-way (controller → worker), Tailscale + WebSocket + bearer token, Python SDK, receiver-side permissions scope tool use.
arguments.metric: First end-to-end round-trip: `mac2mac --target=worker "echo hello && pwd"` from Mac A returns Mac B's pwd output, with bearer-token auth enforced and no Tailscale-bypass path. Then: same call survives a 24h soak (worker daemon stays up, reconnects after sleep).

arguments.action_summary: Wrote full protocol spec in docs/SPEC.md (sections: arch, discovery, pairing, transport, wire protocol, conversation lifecycle with state machine, agent tools, permissions, logging, failure modes, deferred work). Wrote README.md as user-facing entry. Updated AUTONOMY.md with conversation termination decisions. Added explicit design for the bye-bye case: end envelopes are structural and never become user-turns on the receiving side, so A does not auto-respond to B's reciprocal end.
